items.q: So I had done this chart for Dorsey, I had done a thing for Benny Goodman and a thing for Dorsey at the same time

ctx.x: So I had done this chart for Dorsey, I had done a thing for Benny Goodman and a thing for Dorsey at the same time and Jerry was to deliver my scores and pick up the money, and he brought the thing in to Benny and told me they went through it and Benny looked puzzled but gave him the check. I got a letter from Mel Powell regarding that score about a year later saying that the score--
(Tape went blank for a few seconds)
